defs.def: something that you do to make sb believe sth which is not true, or to annoy sb as a joke 诡计；花招；骗局；把戏

ex.s: When a negative review is fake, we get tricked,” Azimi says.
ex.t: “当一条负面评论是假的时，我们就会被骗，”Azimi说。

ex.s: Eva decided to use the same trick to deal with the school building.
ex.t: 伊娃决定用同样的方法来处理学校建筑的问题。

ex.s: Even newspapers, radio and TV stations play tricks on their readers and audiences.
ex.t: 甚至报纸、广播电台和电视台也会捉弄它们的读者和观众。

defs.def: something that confuses you so that you see, understand, remember, etc. things in the wrong way 引起错觉（或记忆紊乱）的事物
a clever action that sb/sth performs as a way of entertaining people 戏法；把戏
a way of doing sth that works well; a good method 技巧；诀窍；窍门

ex.s: Here are a few tricks for remembering what you read.
ex.t: 这里有几个帮助你记住所读内容的技巧。

ex.s: A few minutes later, when I landed the trick, my friends beat their boards loud, shouting: “ Safe!
ex.t: 几分钟后，当我成功完成那个技巧时，朋友们大声拍板，喊着：稳了！

ex.s: Try your hand at some of the painting tricks used by artists whose works will be in the upcoming exhibition of American Watercolors 1880-1990: Into the Light.
ex.t: 亲手尝试一些画家的绘画技巧，他们的作品将出现在即将举办的“美国水彩1880-1990：走进光明”展览中。

ex.s: Safe!” And that's what mattered—landing tricks, being a good skater.
ex.t: 稳了！而那才是重要的——完成技巧，做一个好滑板手。

ex.s: The trick is to start with the ones on the outside.
ex.t: 诀窍是从外面那几块开始。

ex.s: We do this by doing magic tricks, singing songs, telling stories and, of course, telling silly jokes.
ex.t: 我们这样做的方式是做魔术，唱歌，讲故事，当然，讲愚蠢的笑话。

ex.s: While the doctor concentrates on examining Lara’s ankle, I get her attention by doing a magic trick.
ex.t: 在英语课上，我们经常对一篇文本的整体和细节把握进行深入分析。

ex.s: Specially trained clowns visit health care facilities and use magic tricks, music, storytelling and other clowning skills to entertain children and make the hospital feel more welcoming.
ex.t: 经过专门培训的小丑会拜访医疗机构，用魔术、音乐、讲故事和其他小丑技巧来娱乐孩子们，让医院感觉更温馨。

ex.s: Feeling desperate, Eva started using a mind trick on herself.
ex.t: 感到绝望的伊娃开始对自己使用心理技巧。

defs.def: the cards that you play or win in a single part of a card game 一圈；一墩；一圈所打（或赢）的牌
intended to trick sb 意在欺骗的；容易使人上当的
weak and not working well 身体部位
